name: Euclid DR1 SIR Combined Spectra
description: Euclid is a space-based survey observatory launched by the European Space Agency (ESA) in July 2023, which aims to map the large-scale structure of the Universe to better understand dark energy and dark matter. The first stage of Data Release 1 (DR1 Foundation) was released on 12 November 2026. This is the DR1 table sir_combined_spectra from the SIR (NISP slitless spectroscopy) products, with 309,078,775 rows, converted to HATS by IRSA.
